name: Criminal Underworld Info
description: You are connected in the world of organized crime. If you need to find a guy who knows a guy, or have some loot to fence, you know how to do it.

name: Deep Space Knowledge
description: You have experience in the inhabited worlds beyond Earth and knowledge of various stellar bodies outside the solar system.

name: History
description: You have a deep knowledge of various historical facts from around the world.

name: Magical Lore
description: You have studied occult tomes and know all kinds of details of the mystical and arcane realms.

name: Medicine
description: You have training in treating illness and injury.

name: Otherworldly Mythos
description: You have gazed into other dimensions such as the Realm of Discord and returned with strange knowledge.

name: Science
description: You know about physical sciences such as physics, biology, and more.

name: Technology
description: You are an expert in engineering and computers.

name: Alertness
description: You have worked on training your natural or unnatural senses to be alert at all times.

name: Conviction
description: You believe in a cause or a faith so strongly that it drives you to great heights.

name: Creativity
description: You are practiced in a creative field, perhaps painting, singing, or interpretative dance.

name: Investigation
description: You have training in investigation, from evidence collecting techniques to forensic styles.

name: Self-Discipline
description: After practiced meditation and honed willpower, you have incredible depths of discipline over your emotions.

name: Acrobatics
description: You are trained in all manner of gymnastic and aerial maneuvers.

name: Close Combat
description: You can fight up close: it might be with melee weapons, it might be martial arts, or it might be plain old fashioned punching.

name: Finesse
description: You are very precise with your hands and can pull off defusing a bomb or picking a pocket.

name: Fitness
description: You are in top physical shape and can run long distances without getting tired.

name: Ranged Combat
description: You are skilled in attacking from afar, whether it be with guns, archery, or suit-mounted lasers.

name: Stealth
description: You are an expert at sneaking in any environment.

name: Banter
description: You have a gift for gab that sometimes can be used to annoy your enemies (or friends).

name: Imposing
description: You know how to make yourself intimidating to your foes.

name: Insight
description: You can read people and determine what they're trying to hide.

name: Leadership
description: You can lead and direct your allies effectively.

name: Persuasion
description: You can convince others that what you're saying is in their best interest.
